name: UPC Technology Corporation
summary: UPC Technology Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of petrochemical products in China, Taiwan, and internationally. It offers phthalic anhydride; plasticizers; specialty plasticizers, non-phthalate plasticizer, polymeric plasticizer, linear plasticizer, adipate plasticizer, trimellitate plasticizer, bio-based plasticizer, and other specialty plasticizer; polyvinyl chloride; anhydrides and acids, unsaturated polyester resins; polyester polyol; fatty ester; and other specialty chemicals for industrial applications.
